# Inventory (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The AI inventory and the agent register checks.

## Files

- `inventory-records.ts`: Turns AI inventory rows into API records, with the agent register readiness checks.
- `inventory-routes.ts`: The AI inventory: list, add and update systems and agents.
